fixtures: Shell sandbox cases. Each setup script (evals/files/<case>.sh, built on evals/files/sandbox.sh) makes a world in the run's directory: Downloads/, the Apple Music auto-import folder and library under Music/Media.localized/, a NAS staging folder NAS/, and the plugin's config.json under config/, which the session's project settings point MEDIA_MGMT_CONFIG_PATH at (every other MEDIA_MGMT_* variable is blanked, so no real path leaks in). Audio is real: short tagged tones made by ffmpeg, zipped the way stores ship them. The evidence (evals/files/evidence.sh) lists every file added, removed or changed since setup, the whole tree, every MP3's tags as ffprobe reads them, config.json, and, for Apple Music, the stub osascript's calls and playlists.

evals.name: import-and-stop
evals.prompt: metadata's all set on ./Downloads/Night Drive - Afterglow — add it to Apple Music
evals.expected_output: Copies the 4 MP3s (not cover.jpg) into Apple Music's auto-import folder (Music/Media.localized/Automatically Add to Music.localized), leaves the originals in place, then asks the user to check in Apple Music that it shows as one album with the right artist and track order, and stops: no archive to the NAS, no cleanup.
assertions: The evidence shows the 4 MP3s added to Music/Media.localized/Automatically Add to Music.localized/
cover.jpg was not copied into the auto-import folder
The 4 MP3s are still in Downloads/Night Drive - Afterglow (copied, not moved)
Nothing was added under NAS/ and nothing in Downloads was deleted
Asks the user to check in Apple Music that the tracks appear as one album with the right artist and order before going further

evals.name: refuses-wavs
evals.prompt: add ./Downloads/Night Drive - Afterglow-wav to Apple Music too, so I have the lossless versions in my library
evals.expected_output: Does not import: WAVs never go through Apple Music (the library already has the MP3s, so they would be duplicates; lossless files belong on the NAS). Offers to archive the WAVs to the NAS instead. Nothing is copied into the auto-import folder.
assertions: The evidence shows no files added to the auto-import folder or anywhere else
Explains that WAVs are not imported into Apple Music in this workflow because the MP3s are already in the library (they would be duplicates)
Offers archiving the WAVs to the NAS as the place for the lossless files

evals.name: import-then-archive-gate
evals.prompt: metadata's all set on ./Downloads/Night Drive - Afterglow. Add it to Apple Music, and once it's in, send the folder to the NAS so I can clear it out of Downloads.
evals.expected_output: Copies the 4 MP3s (not cover.jpg) into Apple Music's auto-import folder, then stops at the verification gate: it asks the user to open Apple Music and confirm the album shows as one album with the right artist and order, and says the archive to the NAS waits for that confirmation, since a bad import is fixed from the files in Downloads. Nothing is added under NAS/ and nothing is removed from Downloads.
assertions: The evidence shows the 4 MP3s added to Music/Media.localized/Automatically Add to Music.localized/ and cover.jpg not copied there
The evidence shows nothing added under NAS/: the archive was not started
The evidence shows nothing removed from Downloads: the 4 MP3s are still in Downloads/Night Drive - Afterglow
Asks the user to check in Apple Music that the tracks appear as one album with the right artist and order
Says the archive to the NAS waits until the user confirms the import looks right, rather than just asking whether to proceed
